news.title: Rehab Poster Accepted at ISMAR Adjunct 2025
news.excerpt: Our research on 'Towards a Modular XR Platform for Personalized Upper Limb Rehab' has been accepted to the IEEE International Symposium on Mixed and Augmented Reality.
news.content: The Human Computer Interaction Lab at IIIT Sri City has been developing personalized therapy solutions using extended reality technologies, adaptive algorithms, and interactive rehabilitation systems.
news.author: HCI Lab Team

news.title: EEG Poster Accepted at ISMAR Adjunct 2025
news.excerpt: This study presents a comprehensive investigation of the neural correlates of locomotion in extended reality, combining high-density EEG with systematically varied environments and interaction techniques.
news.content: The study analyzes how different locomotion methods and virtual environments affect brain activity measured by EEG to better understand neural dynamics, cognitive load, and motor control during extended reality experiences. It offers insights for designing more intuitive XR locomotion interfaces and adaptive brain-driven navigation systems.
news.author: HCI Lab Team

news.title: XR Hackathon '25: Student Innovation in Extended Reality
news.excerpt: The annual XR Hackathon brings together students and researchers to develop spatial computing applications, immersive environments, and assistive technologies.
news.content: Organized by the HCI Lab at IIIT Sri City, the XR Hackathon provides an interdisciplinary platform for students to prototype extended reality solutions, collaborate with peers and research mentors, and explore novel interaction paradigms.
news.author: HCI Lab Team

news.title: Global Game Jam '25 Hosted at IIIT Sri City
news.excerpt: Over 80 developers, artists, and sound designers participated in the 48-hour global game development challenge hosted by the HCI Lab.
news.content: Focusing on inclusive game design, interactive narrative engines, and novel control mechanics, participants produced 14 playable prototypes evaluated by faculty and industry mentors.
news.author: HCI Lab Team

news.title: DPLA-Retriever: Single-GPU Neural Retrieval for 21M Passages
news.excerpt: Under review at ACM WWW 2026, introducing dual-phase lexical-aware neural retrieval capable of co-locating with LLMs on single GPUs.
news.content: Led by lab researchers Chaitanya Anand and Dr. Himangshu Sarma, DPLA-Retriever achieves competitive nDCG@10 scores while slashing VRAM footprints, enabling accessible neural search on commodity hardware.
news.author: Chaitanya Anand

news.title: EgoScore: Steerable Topological Memory Graph for Smart Glasses
news.excerpt: Under review at ACM CHI 2027, introducing multi-signal perceptual importance scoring and Poincaré hyperbolic event graph indexing for wearable lifelogging.
news.content: Developed at the HCI Lab IIIT Sri City by Chaitanya Anand and Dr. Himangshu Sarma, EgoScore bridges cognitive memory theory and egocentric computer vision for always-on smart glasses (Meta Ray-Ban). By fusing 6 orthogonal perceptual signals with Ebbinghaus temporal decay, the system empowers users with steerable retrieval across daily life archives.
news.author: Chaitanya Anand

news.title: GraphCLaRa: Causal Representation Partitioning in Dense Retrieval
news.excerpt: Under review at ACM CIKM 2026, decoupling semantic alignment from reasoning potential via causal partition masks and differentiable PageRank routing.
news.content: GraphCLaRa establishes a new paradigm in neural retrieval by imposing architecturally disjoint reasoning and semantic sub-representations within a single forward pass over DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models, achieving 81.2% NQ Recall@5 under controlled corpus conditions.
news.author: HCI Lab Team
